purpose: A bounded follow-up pilot testing whether a multiplicative AutoCon representation gate preserves the short-horizon forecast while retaining the contrastive representation objective.
research_question: Does bounded representation-conditioned modulation outperform the prior additive AutoCon correction and remain competitive with the plain BiPatchMamba control?
architecture: BiPatchMamba uses bidirectional Mamba-1 over patch/variable tokens. The pilot enables mamba_bipatch_repr_gate only for the AutoCon null and active arms; the gate is a bounded multiplicative modulation initialized at the supervised forecast.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory pilot. No held-out test metric is generated, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: A pilot pass licenses a frozen confirmation protocol only; it does not establish universal superiority or general speed claims.
prelaunch_gates: verify all four registered dataset fingerprints and multivariate dimensions
verify plain, exact lambda-zero null, and active AutoCon graph pairing with fresh seeds
verify the representation gate is disabled for plain and enabled only for null/active arms
keep skip_test=true and save_predictions=false for every job
do not mix pilot validation rows with the earlier additive-correction screen as a confirmatory estimate

phases.name: bipatch_autocon_null_gate_pilot_h12
phases.purpose: Exact AutoCon graph with lambda zero and bounded representation gate enabled.

phases.name: bipatch_autocon_active_gate_pilot_h12
phases.purpose: Active AutoCon objective with bounded representation gate enabled.

primary_contrasts: active gate versus fresh plain BiPatch
null gate versus fresh plain BiPatch
comparison_contract.autocon_gate: Active gate must be within 1% of null gate; an improvement claim additionally requires lower mean MSE and both paired seed wins.
comparison_contract.gate_gate: A structural gate pass requires active gate to improve over the prior additive active arm on the same dataset only as contextual evidence; this is not a paired confirmatory comparison because source snapshots differ.

stopping_rules: Do not alter architecture, patching, Mamba settings, lambda, optimizer, split, seeds, or epoch budget after launch.
Do not claim a standalone AutoCon gain if active gate fails the exact null contrast.
Do not release held-out test metrics from this pilot.
